releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.29:
- Hardware & Software Health Sentinel: Real-time dual diagnostic monitor located in Options -> Cashier tab (Card G) providing instant health thermometers, live telemetry, and actionable diagnostic guidance for all physical devices (Printers, Cash Drawer, Scales, Barcode Scanners, KDS Screens, Biometrics, Terminals, Network) and software components (Main Comanda Cart, Drink Selector, Cake Calendar, Database Engine, Bilingual Engine, Spooler).
- Touch-Friendly Drinks & Beverages Modal: Smart category folders (Sodas/Refrescos, Juices & Waters, Hot Coffee/Drinks, Energy Drinks, Complete Catalog) with instant pop-up window (modalDrinksGroup) eliminating raw unorganized catalog lists.
- Resilient Cake Calendar & Event Date Picker: Bulletproof event listener shield protecting mouse and touch date selection from Chromium thread collisions, pre-filling default delivery dates and adding a dedicated 1-click Date button.
- 100% Quality Bottle Standard: Certified with 36 automated pre-flight vector tests passing at 100.0% zero defects.
